title: Folded contact sheet
description: An architectural contact sheet unfolds the selected photograph while its neighbors close into connected paper folds.
useCase: Browse a short photographic collection while keeping every image spatially connected.
interaction: Drag the photographs, choose one, or use the arrows. Left, Right, Home and End navigate directly.

assets.description: Chartres Cathedral, West Facade; Royal Portal, Central Bay
Modern brutalist architecture with geometric shapes
Rue de la Montagne-Sainte-Geneviève near the Intersection of Rue LaPlace (Rue de la Montagne-Sainte-Geneviève prés de carrefour de la rue LaPlace)

reducedMotion: Selection changes are immediate; direct dragging remains available. Host pause freezes spring interpolation.
limitations: Five local photographs with bounded selection; no wrapping, routing or separate lightbox.
look: Cobalt-blue field with a strip of architectural photographs, one open flat and the rest folded into zigzag paper pleats, serif caption and round arrow buttons.
motion: Dragging, clicking or the arrow buttons drive a spring-smoothed focus position; photo widths follow it and each photo's two halves fold in 3D like a concertina, darkening as they close.
adapt: The `paint` function divides `available` by distance weights to calculate each photo's projected width. Fixed-size `.fc-half` spans fold with `Math.acos(Math.min(1, width / flat))` and translate in 3D; their HTML width is not tweened. Geometry is measured on resize, while `tick` springs `position` toward `target` (`270`, `32`). Replace `photographs` and their captions.
